adds.title: Crime in Vatican City
adds.summary: Vatican City operates no prison system: the article states there are only a few cells used for pre-trial detention, and persons sentenced to imprisonment by Vatican City serve their time in Italian prisons, with costs covered by Vatican City. Because no domestic prison system exists, there is no trans-specific prisoner-placement policy, trans custody facility, or documented trans-prisoner placement case for this jurisdiction. (Last-resort encyclopedic source; no separate State Department Holy See chapter for 2023/2024 exists.)

records.note: No prison system exists in this jurisdiction; no trans prisoner-housing policy, facility or case record is possible or documented here.

adds.title: CHRC says transgender rights are observed in prison
adds.summary: Khmer Times (19 Feb 2025) reports Cambodian Human Rights Committee (CHRC) president Keo Remy, speaking at the handover of an ambulance to Correctional Centre 2 at Prey Sar prison in Phnom Penh, said Cambodia observes transgender prisoners' rights: transgender offenders who have undergone sex-change surgery are transferred from Correctional Centre 1 (the men's facility) to Correctional Centre 2 (the women's facility). The statement was made in praise of the centre, not as a published regulation, and no statute or formal policy text is cited; the article also flags that prison overcrowding has worsened because of gang-crackdown arrests. This is the only direct documentation of trans-prisoner placement practice for Cambodia found in two search rounds.

records.note: Placement practice documented via a national human-rights committee president's statement: transfer of transgender offenders to the women's centre occurs after sex-change surgery; no law/regulation-level placement rule was located.
